What happened in Heidelberg?

By: Anina Peens | Commission

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Exactly one year ago, Dylan Bothma mysteriously dies on the R23 outside Heidelberg. Was it suicide? Or was it murder?

Unique Selling Point:
He was a beautiful young man, wrote and played songs on his guitar...as an 18 year old, he had the world at his feet. Why did he suddenly commit suicide? or did he?

Summary:
A young man dies, mysteriously on the R23 hiway outside Heidelberg in Gauteng after attending a 16th birthday party. He was killed in an alleged hit and run…but the driver of the Mercedes Benz that hit Dylan Bothma, has been questioned and the case dismissed, an accident. But according to eyewitnesses, the Mercedes that pulled him 25 meters down the road, was the second car to hit 18 year old Bothma who was said to have been walking home from the party at the time. But his house was in the opposite direction of the R23, and eyewitnesses say, what they saw, was not an accident.
But the case concluded without the police taking in one piece of evidence for forensic analysis and without one photo in the docket. Dylan’s family was finally forced to believe their sunshine child who was always smiling, committed suicide.


Further information:
Several teenagers who attended a 16th birthday party on the night of 24 June 2024, are receiving counseling at the Hoër Volkskool, a well-known high school with a rich Afrikaner history.
Many learners saw what happened on the nigh Dylan died, but the school has distanced itself from the investigation in an attempt to protect the young eyewitnesses who are said to be severely traumatized.

For Dylan’s parents, this brings no consolation. They’re unable to find peace and let their son go without knowing what happened to him. Elsie has a timeline on the wall of her home office, the center of what the family deems, a murder investigation.

FURTHER INFORMATION
Dylan was invited to the 16th birthday party of a girl he was apparently dating. Other teenagers who also attended the party said in their statements that Dylan was dancing on his own and several described him as ‘being in his own world’. Dylan’s mother, Elsie Bothma says, her husband dropped Dylan off at the party and while driving there, Dylan said, he didn’t feel like going to the party, not ‘feeling like all the drama’, his father later said. There was another young gentleman at the party, also apparently dating Dylan’s girlfriend.
The young girl’s father, Riaan Strydom is described by locals as drug dealer who often hosted parties that were popular in the sleepy town.
Some teenagers said in statements that they saw how Riaan forced Dylan to eat a marijuana biscuit, which Dylan allegedly did. Afterwards he was dancing on his own again. He then went to sit down and eyewitnesses say they saw Riaan approached him and started to hit him. A major fight broke out in which Dylan, according to witnesses didn’t participate. Instead, he ran away. But a group of men followed him and continuedly hit him. For some reason, the fight ended up on the R23, a hiway, a couple of street blocks away. It is not clear how the group ended up here, but later, Riaan and his family said in a statement, Dylan was walking home from the party. But the R23 is in the opposite direction and there was no reason for Dylan to walk that way. He was also accompanied by the men that continuedly hit him. One of the boys present later said he was not participating in the fight but that he saw how Dylan was dragged to the R23 from Riaan’s house. He later withdrew his statement and said he saw nothing.
Then, the strangest thing happened; while they were fighting in the road, a tow truck from Autotech towing, one of Heidelberg’s most well know companies comes speeding down the R23. This was just after 7pm.
Another eyewitness, just know as ‘Search’ was waiting across the R23 for his brother to finish his dayshift as a caretaker at the prison opposite the scene. Search described in a statement how he saw the towtruck driving in Dylan’s direction. And then, the group of boys/men threw Dylan in front of the truck after which it spun off. A man and his wife came driving along the route directly following the towtruck that hit Dylan. In their blue Mercedez Benz, they were driving over 80km an hour and say, they didn’t see Dylan lying in the road. Consequently, the Mercedes hit Dylan again, this time pulling him 25 meters down the road.

It is not clear what happened next and how the police arrived on the scene and when Dylan was taken to hospital. But while this was happening, Dylan’s parents were trying to get a hold of him. His father drove to Riaan’s house. Riaan was not home. The birthday girl said, Dylan left the party at 6pm, her sister said, Dylan left at 9pm. Dylan’s parents knew, something was amiss.

The family contacted Van Zyl Schultsz from the community policing forum who then posted a message on a community/security WhatsApp group. A man by the name of Bongani, another driver for Autotech posted that there was an accident on the R23 and a young man was involved. The parents rushed to the scene where the ambulance had already arrived. The ambulance rushed a heavily wounded Dylan to the Suikerbosrand hospital. The doctor on duty apparently refused to treat Dylan as the hospital was not geared to treat such heavily wounded patients and sent Dylan to the Unie hospital in Alberton, where he was declared dead on arrival.

WHY IT’S A CARTE BLANCHE STORY
When Bongani posted on the community WhatsApp group that a man was hit by a car on the R23, Van Zyl Schults rushed to the scene. Dylan had just been taken away by the ambulance when Schultz arrived. He immediately took photos of the scene when he was approached by Andries, a street dweller who also saw what happened. Andries told Schultz that there was another witness who saw what happened; the man waiting for his brother at the prison.
He would later be identified as ‘Search’.

The police never cordoned off the scene and never treated it like a crime scene. Up to this day, the forensic team did not take one photo of the crime. In the ‘hit and run’ of the first car that Search was a witness to, a part of the light of the tow truck came loose. Schultz found it on the scene and gave it to Elsie. The police dont see this as evidence but it is clearly a broken light that was part of a tow truck’s emergency light. Up to this day, no one has ever questioned Autotech and the teenagers who saw what happened are not allowed to speak as their parents distance themselves from the case.

It is interesting that Riaan was known by locals as the drug dealer who gave drugs to underaged children. Only the teenagers can testify to this. But after the incident, Riaan packed his bags and left Heidelberg.
He is believed to be long term friends with the lead SAPS investigator in the case, Capt. Wessels. Together, Riaan, the owner of the Autotech, Johan Kleynhans and Capt. Wessels served the police force as colleagues in Heidelberg for 30 years.

By: Anina Peens | Commission Proposal Show: One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Exactly one year ago, Dylan Bothma mysteriously dies on the R23 outside Heidelberg. Was it suicide? Or was it murder? Unique Selling Point: He was a beautiful young man, wrote and played songs on his guitar...as an 18 year old, he had the world at his feet. Why did he suddenly commit suicide? or did he? Summary: A young man dies, mysteriously on the R23 hiway outside Heidelberg in Gauteng after attending a 16th birthday party. He was killed in an alleged hit and run…but the driver of the Mercedes Benz that hit Dylan Bothma, has been questioned and the case dismissed, an accident. But according to eyewitnesses, the Mercedes that pulled him 25 meters down the road, was the second car to hit 18 year old Bothma who was said to have been walking home from the party at the time. But his house was in the opposite direction of the R23, and eyewitnesses say, what they saw, was not an accident. But the case concluded without the police taking in one piece of evidence for forensic analysis and without one photo in the docket. Dylan’s family was finally forced to believe their sunshine child who was always smiling, committed suicide. Further information: Several teenagers who attended a 16th birthday party on the night of 24 June 2024, are receiving counseling at the Hoër Volkskool, a well-known high school with a rich Afrikaner history. Many learners saw what happened on the nigh Dylan died, but the school has distanced itself from the investigation in an attempt to protect the young eyewitnesses who are said to be severely traumatized. For Dylan’s parents, this brings no consolation. They’re unable to find peace and let their son go without knowing what happened to him. Elsie has a timeline on the wall of her home office, the center of what the family deems, a murder investigation. FURTHER INFORMATION Dylan was invited to the 16th birthday party of a girl he was apparently dating. Other teenagers who also attended the party said in their statements that Dylan was dancing on his own and several described him as ‘being in his own world’. Dylan’s mother, Elsie Bothma says, her husband dropped Dylan off at the party and while driving there, Dylan said, he didn’t feel like going to the party, not ‘feeling like all the drama’, his father later said. There was another young gentleman at the party, also apparently dating Dylan’s girlfriend. The young girl’s father, Riaan Strydom is described by locals as drug dealer who often hosted parties that were popular in the sleepy town. Some teenagers said in statements that they saw how Riaan forced Dylan to eat a marijuana biscuit, which Dylan allegedly did. Afterwards he was dancing on his own again. He then went to sit down and eyewitnesses say they saw Riaan approached him and started to hit him. A major fight broke out in which Dylan, according to witnesses didn’t participate. Instead, he ran away. But a group of men followed him and continuedly hit him. For some reason, the fight ended up on the R23, a hiway, a couple of street blocks away. It is not clear how the group ended up here, but later, Riaan and his family said in a statement, Dylan was walking home from the party. But the R23 is in the opposite direction and there was no reason for Dylan to walk that way. He was also accompanied by the men that continuedly hit him. One of the boys present later said he was not participating in the fight but that he saw how Dylan was dragged to the R23 from Riaan’s house. He later withdrew his statement and said he saw nothing. Then, the strangest thing happened; while they were fighting in the road, a tow truck from Autotech towing, one of Heidelberg’s most well know companies comes speeding down the R23. This was just after 7pm. Another eyewitness, just know as ‘Search’ was waiting across the R23 for his brother to finish his dayshift as a caretaker at the prison opposite the scene. Search described in a statement how he saw the towtruck driving in Dylan’s direction. And then, the group of boys/men threw Dylan in front of the truck after which it spun off. A man and his wife came driving along the route directly following the towtruck that hit Dylan. In their blue Mercedez Benz, they were driving over 80km an hour and say, they didn’t see Dylan lying in the road. Consequently, the Mercedes hit Dylan again, this time pulling him 25 meters down the road. It is not clear what happened next and how the police arrived on the scene and when Dylan was taken to hospital. But while this was happening, Dylan’s parents were trying to get a hold of him. His father drove to Riaan’s house. Riaan was not home. The birthday girl said, Dylan left the party at 6pm, her sister said, Dylan left at 9pm. Dylan’s parents knew, something was amiss. The family contacted Van Zyl Schultsz from the community policing forum who then posted a message on a community/security WhatsApp group. A man by the name of Bongani, another driver for Autotech posted that there was an accident on the R23 and a young man was involved. The parents rushed to the scene where the ambulance had already arrived. The ambulance rushed a heavily wounded Dylan to the Suikerbosrand hospital. The doctor on duty apparently refused to treat Dylan as the hospital was not geared to treat such heavily wounded patients and sent Dylan to the Unie hospital in Alberton, where he was declared dead on arrival. WHY IT’S A CARTE BLANCHE STORY When Bongani posted on the community WhatsApp group that a man was hit by a car on the R23, Van Zyl Schults rushed to the scene. Dylan had just been taken away by the ambulance when Schultz arrived. He immediately took photos of the scene when he was approached by Andries, a street dweller who also saw what happened. Andries told Schultz that there was another witness who saw what happened; the man waiting for his brother at the prison. He would later be identified as ‘Search’. The police never cordoned off the scene and never treated it like a crime scene. Up to this day, the forensic team did not take one photo of the crime. In the ‘hit and run’ of the first car that Search was a witness to, a part of the light of the tow truck came loose. Schultz found it on the scene and gave it to Elsie. The police dont see this as evidence but it is clearly a broken light that was part of a tow truck’s emergency light. Up to this day, no one has ever questioned Autotech and the teenagers who saw what happened are not allowed to speak as their parents distance themselves from the case. It is interesting that Riaan was known by locals as the drug dealer who gave drugs to underaged children. Only the teenagers can testify to this. But after the incident, Riaan packed his bags and left Heidelberg. He is believed to be long term friends with the lead SAPS investigator in the case, Capt. Wessels. Together, Riaan, the owner of the Autotech, Johan Kleynhans and Capt. Wessels served the police force as colleagues in Heidelberg for 30 years. metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Exactly one year ago, Dylan Bothma mysteriously dies on the R23 outside Heidelberg. Was it suicide? Or was it murder?
metadata.Unique Selling Point: He was a beautiful young man, wrote and played songs on his guitar...as an 18 year old, he had the world at his feet. Why did he suddenly commit suicide? or did he?
metadata.Summary: A young man dies, mysteriously on the R23 hiway outside Heidelberg in Gauteng after attending a 16th birthday party. He was killed in an alleged hit and run…but the driver of the Mercedes Benz that hit Dylan Bothma, has been questioned and the case dismissed, an accident. But according to eyewitnesses, the Mercedes that pulled him 25 meters down the road, was the second car to hit 18 year old Bothma who was said to have been walking home from the party at the time. But his house was in the opposite direction of the R23, and eyewitnesses say, what they saw, was not an accident. But the case concluded without the police taking in one piece of evidence for forensic analysis and without one photo in the docket. Dylan’s family was finally forced to believe their sunshine child who was always smiling, committed suicide.
metadata.Further information: Several teenagers who attended a 16th birthday party on the night of 24 June 2024, are receiving counseling at the Hoër Volkskool, a well-known high school with a rich Afrikaner history. Many learners saw what happened on the nigh Dylan died, but the school has distanced itself from the investigation in an attempt to protect the young eyewitnesses who are said to be severely traumatized. For Dylan’s parents, this brings no consolation. They’re unable to find peace and let their son go without knowing what happened to him. Elsie has a timeline on the wall of her home office, the center of what the family deems, a murder investigation. FURTHER INFORMATION Dylan was invited to the 16th birthday party of a girl he was apparently dating. Other teenagers who also attended the party said in their statements that Dylan was dancing on his own and several described him as ‘being in his own world’. Dylan’s mother, Elsie Bothma says, her husband dropped Dylan off at the party and while driving there, Dylan said, he didn’t feel like going to the party, not ‘feeling like all the drama’, his father later said. There was another young gentleman at the party, also apparently dating Dylan’s girlfriend. The young girl’s father, Riaan Strydom is described by locals as drug dealer who often hosted parties that were popular in the sleepy town. Some teenagers said in statements that they saw how Riaan forced Dylan to eat a marijuana biscuit, which Dylan allegedly did. Afterwards he was dancing on his own again. He then went to sit down and eyewitnesses say they saw Riaan approached him and started to hit him. A major fight broke out in which Dylan, according to witnesses didn’t participate. Instead, he ran away. But a group of men followed him and continuedly hit him. For some reason, the fight ended up on the R23, a hiway, a couple of street blocks away. It is not clear how the group ended up here, but later, Riaan and his family said in a statement, Dylan was walking home from the party. But the R23 is in the opposite direction and there was no reason for Dylan to walk that way. He was also accompanied by the men that continuedly hit him. One of the boys present later said he was not participating in the fight but that he saw how Dylan was dragged to the R23 from Riaan’s house. He later withdrew his statement and said he saw nothing. Then, the strangest thing happened; while they were fighting in the road, a tow truck from Autotech towing, one of Heidelberg’s most well know companies comes speeding down the R23. This was just after 7pm. Another eyewitness, just know as ‘Search’ was waiting across the R23 for his brother to finish his dayshift as a caretaker at the prison opposite the scene. Search described in a statement how he saw the towtruck driving in Dylan’s direction. And then, the group of boys/men threw Dylan in front of the truck after which it spun off. A man and his wife came driving along the route directly following the towtruck that hit Dylan. In their blue Mercedez Benz, they were driving over 80km an hour and say, they didn’t see Dylan lying in the road. Consequently, the Mercedes hit Dylan again, this time pulling him 25 meters down the road. It is not clear what happened next and how the police arrived on the scene and when Dylan was taken to hospital. But while this was happening, Dylan’s parents were trying to get a hold of him. His father drove to Riaan’s house. Riaan was not home. The birthday girl said, Dylan left the party at 6pm, her sister said, Dylan left at 9pm. Dylan’s parents knew, something was amiss. The family contacted Van Zyl Schultsz from the community policing forum who then posted a message on a community/security WhatsApp group. A man by the name of Bongani, another driver for Autotech posted that there was an accident on the R23 and a young man was involved. The parents rushed to the scene where the ambulance had already arrived. The ambulance rushed a heavily wounded Dylan to the Suikerbosrand hospital. The doctor on duty apparently refused to treat Dylan as the hospital was not geared to treat such heavily wounded patients and sent Dylan to the Unie hospital in Alberton, where he was declared dead on arrival. WHY IT’S A CARTE BLANCHE STORY When Bongani posted on the community WhatsApp group that a man was hit by a car on the R23, Van Zyl Schults rushed to the scene. Dylan had just been taken away by the ambulance when Schultz arrived. He immediately took photos of the scene when he was approached by Andries, a street dweller who also saw what happened. Andries told Schultz that there was another witness who saw what happened; the man waiting for his brother at the prison. He would later be identified as ‘Search’. The police never cordoned off the scene and never treated it like a crime scene. Up to this day, the forensic team did not take one photo of the crime. In the ‘hit and run’ of the first car that Search was a witness to, a part of the light of the tow truck came loose. Schultz found it on the scene and gave it to Elsie. The police dont see this as evidence but it is clearly a broken light that was part of a tow truck’s emergency light. Up to this day, no one has ever questioned Autotech and the teenagers who saw what happened are not allowed to speak as their parents distance themselves from the case. It is interesting that Riaan was known by locals as the drug dealer who gave drugs to underaged children. Only the teenagers can testify to this. But after the incident, Riaan packed his bags and left Heidelberg. He is believed to be long term friends with the lead SAPS investigator in the case, Capt. Wessels. Together, Riaan, the owner of the Autotech, Johan Kleynhans and Capt. Wessels served the police force as colleagues in Heidelberg for 30 years.
